verdict.rationale: Brevo documents unlimited automated, multi-step workflows, so this lifecycle-automation axis applies to it. However, nothing in the evidence shows a per-contact view of where someone sits in a workflow, or controls to remove or re-enter a contact mid-flow without disrupting it. Generic workflow and contact-management claims are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see where any individual person sits inside an automation and pull or re-enter them without breaking the flow
